patterns: APPSC asks short definitional items: TRIPS = intellectual property, blue-box = production-limiting trade-distorting subsidies.
Other PSCs recycle basics: WTO est. 1995, HQ Geneva, earlier GATT, Dunkel/Uruguay Round linked to GATT, MC venues (Doha = Qatar, MC13 Abu Dhabi).
Box subsidies (amber/blue/green; red/white as distractors), AoA three pillars, Peace Clause and SSM recur as 'in the context of which organisation' items.
TRIPS compliance laws (GI Act 1999, Patents amendments) are a common India angle.
App MCQs go much deeper into 2025-26 developments (MC14 Yaounde, IFD, AFS acceptance number, Appellate Body/MPIA, disputes) than any PYQ; PYQs stay at name/venue/definition level.
